newsitem.title: UK: Cater Allen Holdings dips on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Cater Allen Holdings dips on H1 results.

text.p: Shares of Cater Allen Holdings dropped on Friday after the financial services group announced a sharply reduced first-half profit, largely due to difficult trading conditions in the sterling money market.
The stock was down 15-1/2p to 366, after the company said pre-tax profit dropped to 5.62 million stg in the six months to October 31 from 9.44 million in the same period last year.
"The profit reflects the difficult trading conditions in the sterling money market over this period," the company said. "We expect to see a distinct improvement in our results in the second half."
The group said deposits in its retail banking division were growing strongly and the margins in its gilt repo market were improving. The interim dividend was held at 9p.
